address: Shop 2206, 2F, The Londoner, Estrada do lstmo, Cotai, Macau
bio: As well as a neighbourhood of Lisbon, Chiado is celebrity chef Henrique Sá Pessoa’s first dining concept outside Portugal. The room is modern and cosy, setting the mood for a feast of Portuguese classics oozing with understated elegance and robust flavours. Choose the 6-course degustation menu to sample all the chef’s signature dishes. Don’t miss the boneless suckling pig that is slow-cooked then grilled, boasting crispy skin and silky meat....
